findings.fixedCode:
def jwt_fixed(token):
    head, body, signature = token.split('.')
    header, claims = decode_part(head), decode_part(body)
    expected = b64(hmac.digest(JWT_KEY, (head + '.' + body).encode(), 'sha256'))
    if (header.get('alg') != 'HS256' or not hmac.compare_digest(signature, expected)
            or claims.get('iss') != 'bountyproof' or claims.get('aud') != 'local-lab'
            or type(claims.get('exp')) is not int or claims['exp'] <= time.time()
            or claims.get('sub') not in ('alice', 'bob')):
        raise ValueError('Invalid token')
    return claims['sub']

findings.title: Session fixation at login
findings.rootCause: Successful login promotes the caller-selected session identifier.
findings.impact: Reuse the known session identifier after victim login.
findings.limitation: Fictional password is public; no credential guessing. Cookies omit Secure for loopback HTTP only.

before.request:
GET /auth/login?password=fictional-alice-password HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8091
Authorization: Bearer fixture-alice
Cookie: sid=known-session

after.request:
GET /auth/login?password=fictional-alice-password HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8092
Authorization: Bearer fixture-alice
Cookie: sid=known-session

positive.request:
GET /auth/me HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8092
Authorization: Bearer fixture-alice
Cookie: sid=IP3H0erlLoVTMnljxDafCTMG2SWUcyUJ-H2mbEHnL0Q

additional.request:
GET /auth/me HTTP/1.1
Host: 127.0.0.1:8091
Authorization: Bearer fixture-alice

findings.fixedCode:
def auth_fixed(password, sid, sessions):
    if not hmac.compare_digest(password, PASSWORD):
        return 401, {'error': 'Bad credentials'}, None
    sessions.pop(sid, None)
    fresh = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    sessions[fresh] = 'alice'
    return 200, {'user': 'alice'}, fresh
